study.question: Can preserving historical field/action value coordinates repair the quality deficit of iterative field/history exchange while retaining its useful event updates? Observed across all recorded trajectories: baseline-din macro AUC 0.809923388, versus exchange_full 0.804828231, exchange_read_only 0.796032245, exchange_fixed_query 0.804114955 and exchange_fixed_both 0.797518256. Every exchange arm is below DIN. Full exchange has AUC deltas versus DIN of -0.006149648 click, -0.005687158 cart, -0.003410341 favorite and -0.005133482 purchase; its macro Logloss is worse by 0.000362613. Full exchange costs 809.07 seconds versus DIN 329.11 seconds despite 257284 versus 266213 dense parameters. This is an unsuccessful architecture so far, not an efficiency result.
study.hypothesis: The local exchange implementation compresses the six item-field embeddings plus action from 112 coordinates to 32 before its narrow value reads. DIN instead exposes the separate historical field coordinates to the task towers. This difference may obscure target-relevant field evidence, even when event routing benefits from field-to-event feedback. In the existing single-seed factorial, event writes add 0.008795986 macro AUC with dynamic queries and 0.006596699 with fixed queries; query evolution adds only 0.000713276 with writes and subtracts 0.001486011 without writes (interaction +0.002199287). These observations motivate a conditional repair, not a claim that compression caused the deficit. Full exchange minus DIN is +0.001161255 in history lengths 1-16, -0.005068462 in 17-64, and -0.004454667 above 64. These exploratory slices motivate the follow-up, but the empty-history macro deficit (-0.016502675) also warns that value loss cannot explain everything. Hypothesis: a final task-specific read using evolved task queries and event keys, with original masked field/action embeddings as values, improves the matched low-rank replacement and can retain a benefit from feedback. The new path remains differentiable through both routing and embedding values.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary text read, especially lines 271-277: DIN deliberately retains interest intensity through unnormalized local activation. We inherit the value-coordinate preservation idea, but use normalized task-query routing after two exchange rounds; we do not reproduce DIN or test its intensity mechanism here.

Primary arXiv:2602.10811v1 PDF, sections 5.1-5.3 inspected at https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.10811; registry full text was unavailable. EST projects tokens and uses non-behavior queries with behavioral keys/values. Our narrow routing plus final original-coordinate value path is a local replacement study, without content inputs or CSA; its effectiveness is unknown.

Pinned benchmark lines 198-282 inspected separately from the original paper. Token-specific query/output transforms and shared key/value projections are architectural precedents; our shared routing, field identities and removable reverse write are inherited local choices. A benchmark implementation is not proof of original-method equivalence.

Primary arXiv:2602.14110v2 sections 3.2-3.3 inspected at https://arxiv.org/html/2602.14110v2, alongside pinned benchmark block lines 187-218. Evolving field-conditioned retrieval is prior work. This study retains its local attention-based field mixer and isolates a wide original-value path rather than adopting HeadMixing, per-head SwiGLU or request sharing.

Primary arXiv:2510.26104v3 methodology inspected at https://arxiv.org/html/2510.26104v3, with pinned block lines 219-252 checked separately. Joint sequential/non-sequential modeling, mixed parameterization and progressive interaction are established precedents. Our final wide-value side read and factorial controls differ from its unified causal backbone, pruning and cache design.

The provided source is the direct architectural parent. The two-round exchange remains; the addition is a task-specific wide-value read and a shape-matched learned low-rank replacement. Event-write controls are rerun because the new value path may interact with their effect.

inherited_components: From g1-r0000-exchange_full: FeatureEmbeddingDict and field selection; raw current-field skip; 16-to-32 shared field projection and 112-to-32 event projection; field/task identities and mask-derived prefix ranks.
From the local exchange family: initial field mixing, two tied field-to-history reads, two after-read field mixers, one removable field-to-event write, task tokens and final field normalization.
From the common reference interface: four probability outputs, separate 128/64 Dice towers, frozen host loss and training recipe. No code or result from a different campaign is imported.
study.proposed_difference: Separate the final retrieval value width from the 32-dimensional routing width. Reuse the existing read Q/K projections with final task states and evolved event keys; average normalized routing weights over heads, and pool only the original visible history item/action embeddings. Append the resulting per-task 112-dimensional summary to each tower. Replace this summary in matched controls by an independently learned 112->32->112 bias-free linear path. By linearity it is applied after pooling to save sequence-wide compute. Apply the same non-affine LayerNorm to both summaries, and explicitly zero empty-history summaries. All arms compute both paths and the write; flags select the value path and enable/suppress event feedback. This tests value-coordinate preservation conditional on a narrow-key architecture. It does not establish recovery of every original field interaction, new scientific priority, or superiority over nearest external models. Originality remains unverified.
predictions: Primary predicted contrast: macroAUC(wide_feedback)>macroAUC(lowrank_feedback); a positive wide_static-lowrank_static effect would extend support beyond event feedback. Do not substitute the best individual task for the four-task macro mean.

Predicted conditional effect: wide_feedback>wide_static if the inherited event-update benefit survives a preserved value path. Report both feedback simple effects and their interaction with value replacement, regardless of sign.

Predeclared diagnostic bins are the already available empty, 1-16, 17-64 and >64 history lengths. Expect the value-path effect to be visible in nonempty histories, particularly >16; report every bin with sample and positive/negative counts for all tasks. Empty histories have only 45/28/13 cart/favorite/purchase positives, so treat those AUCs as unstable diagnostics.

Report macro Logloss and all four task AUC/Logloss deltas versus baseline-din and exchange_full. Use host-measured parameters, training time, inference time/throughput/batch latency and peak GPU memory. Equal registered counts do not justify an efficiency claim.

A value-path benefit is only provisional single-seed controlled evidence until paired validation repetitions. Candidate success additionally requires beating the DIN incumbent under the unchanged selection rule; a partial recovery below DIN remains a negative performance result.
falsifiers: wide_feedback is no better than lowrank_feedback and wide_static is no better than lowrank_static on macro AUC: this implementation provides no support for the preserved-value repair.

Both reconstructed controls match or beat wide values: simpler identity gradients or field-coordinate access did not provide the predicted advantage under this recipe. Do not infer that every possible wide representation is refuted.
wide_feedback does not beat wide_static: the need for event updates does not transfer to the new readout, even if it held in the old family.
Any invalid task, masking/current-action sensitivity, nonfinite forward/backward, cap overrun or failure to finish full-unit evaluation invalidates that arm for selection; failed cost is retained.
Apparent improvements fail paired repetitions or are confined to unstable low-positive slices: report the initial contrast without a robustness or significance claim.
alternative_explanations: Equal registered parameter counts and forward operations do not imply equal active capacity, gradient flow or measured backward cost. The low-rank replacement has additional learned depth; an advantage for the identity path may reflect easier optimization under the fixed one-pass recipe.
After fitting, routing coefficients can diverge between arms through different gradients. The scalar intervention defines the causal architecture contrast, not equality of learned attention maps.
Routing keys and intermediate event states remain compressed to 32 dimensions. The study tests preservation of final historical values, not removal of every information bottleneck.

Shared non-affine LayerNorm reduces scale differences but does not match complete activation distributions. Normalized pooling still discards relevance mass; DIN uses a different local activation and readout.
This is a validation-adaptive, initially single-seed follow-up. Repeated seeds measure robustness, not independent mechanism contrasts; no holdout or production claim follows.

The historical DIN gap may instead arise from learned relevance mass, lost per-field routing detail, field mixer choice, task-token learning, or one-pass optimization. This experiment does not isolate those differences.
The new additional retrieval/readout can improve both wide and reconstructed arms independently of preservation; original exchange comparisons alone cannot attribute a value-rank mechanism.

Official offline actions may include feedback not mature at impression time; auxiliary labels are same-user/category/brand 24-hour events rather than advertisement-specific attribution. No production-causality inference is supported.

Only host-provided history-length slices are currently available. Raw timestamps, full histories, validation user identifiers and per-user predictions are not authorized inputs to this coding phase; user-cluster bootstrap intervals and other requested slices cannot be fabricated.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: g1-r0000-exchange_full (809.07s total, 769.86s train, 29.88s validation inference); the other exchange arms cost 803.48-805.57s. baseline-din costs 329.11s. New final routing uses 4 task queries x 2 heads x at most 101 padded keys, adding no event-event attention. Estimate 950-1100s per arm, unmeasured; the fixed 1208.541376s host cap remains binding. Four caps total 4834.17s. With event_width=112, add 4*128*112+2*112*32=64512 registered dense parameters, giving estimated total 32115012 and dense 321796 per arm; host must confirm.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve 6500s for host integrity gates, attribution follow-ups and paired repetitions of consequential simple effects. Submit four arms now in order wide_feedback, lowrank_feedback, wide_static, lowrank_static. All source checks, provider calls, failed gates, training/scoring, diagnostics and interrupted jobs count in the same wall budget. No training, installations or other agents in the coding jail. Host must gate finite forward/backward, all four [B,1] probabilities, all-padding and zero-length histories, invariance to changed masked IDs and current action, valid event/action sensitivity, aligned initialization across the quartet and identical registered parameter shapes before a substantive run.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 9000s for a frozen validation-only suite targeting three paired seeds of the selected model, its closest value/feedback control and DIN; reuse only receipts with matching source/config/input/protocol hashes and record any omitted seeds. Freeze selected source/config/checkpoint hashes, comparison suite, seeds and exact host commands before assessment. No held-out scoring, predictions, test feedback or closed archives are authorized in this rerun. Bootstrap uncertainty requires an explicitly authorized interface; none is supplied here. Preserve single-seed conclusions if repetitions cannot fit.
cost_plan.stop_rule: The resolved remaining-budget snapshot is 39231.4367s; it is not a new allowance and all elapsed preparation counts. Four maximum-cost arms plus 6500s attribution and 9000s assessment fit within that snapshot with margin. Recheck host ledger before launches. Never exceed the campaign deadline, 43200s total wall limit or the unchanged per-trial cap. Stop on integrity failure, user stop, hard limit, or when no informative admissible full-unit contrast fits while preserving necessary assessment. No automatic duplicate job after unknown completion; retain receipt/cost and resolve state. If all candidates trail DIN, retain DIN and report an unsuccessful repair.
